title: SimplificationState
description: On-disk state for the autonomous simplification orchestrator. Per Gate 16 (docs/PLAN_REQUIREMENTS.md) every plan in this repo defines a similar state file so the orchestrator survives context compaction. The orchestrator reads this on every wake-up, reconciles with live PR state via `gh pr list`, and atomically rewrites on each phase transition. Hand-edits by humans are permitted between cron firings but discouraged during active runs.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file (relative to the state file's location). Tooling uses this for validation.

plan.description: Filename (relative to docs/) of the plan document this state file tracks.

base_branch.description: The git branch the plan's PRs target.

base_sha_at_kickoff.description: Full SHA of the base branch at the moment the orchestrator started. Lets recovery procedures detect rebase drift.

kickoff_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the orchestrator first wrote this state file.

budget_hours.description: Hard wall-clock cap. Beyond `deadline_at` the orchestrator writes BUDGET_EXCEEDED and stops.

budget_revision_at.description: Optional: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the budget was last revised (e.g. after observing actual cadence).

budget_revision_reason.description: Optional: human-readable rationale for the latest budget revision.

deadline_at.description: kickoff_at + budget_hours. The orchestrator never operates past this timestamp.

permission_profile.description: Permission mode the orchestrator declares it needs (per Gate 16 mandatory element #13).

refuse_list.description: Hard-coded actions the orchestrator must refuse regardless of permission mode (per Gate 16). E.g. 'force-push to <base_branch>', 'close PR #<external collaborator>', etc.

timing_observations.description: Empirical timing data captured during the run. Used to refine estimates for future runs.

workstreams.description: Per-WS state. Keys are WS ids (e.g. 'WS-S1', 'WS-M2'). All values follow the Workstream schema below.

phase_progression.description: Ordered list of phase names a WS transitions through. The orchestrator validates `WS.phase` against this list.

monitors.description: IDs of persistent background monitors. null = not currently armed.

merged_count.description: Number of WSes that have reached the 'merged' phase. Updated atomically on each merge.

blocked_count.description: Number of WSes in the 'blocked' phase. Non-zero is a soft-fail signal; the orchestrator continues with eligible WSes but logs the block.

current_orchestrator_action.description: What the orchestrator believes it's currently doing. Updated on every state-file rewrite. Useful for debugging after context compaction.

wave.description: Wave number. Integers for primary waves; strings for sub-waves.

phase.description: Current phase. Must be one of the values in the parent's `phase_progression` list.

worktree.description: Relative path to the git worktree this WS owns. null is allowed only for WSes that don't produce a code PR (e.g. WS-H opens a GitHub issue, no worktree needed); when null, `branch` MUST also be null and the WS docstring MUST explain why.

branch.description: Git branch name for this WS's PR. null only when worktree is null (see worktree description).

depends_on.description: List of WS ids that must reach 'merged' before this WS leaves 'pending'.

owns.description: File paths (or path patterns) this WS owns. Used by the orchestrator's disjoint-file-ownership check per Gate 16.

pr_number.description: GitHub PR number after `scripts/create_pr.py` / `gh pr create`. null before.

head_sha.description: Current HEAD of the WS's branch. Updated after every push.

retry_count.description: Retry counter per the orchestrator's deterministic decision rules. Escalation to architect happens at >=2.

plan_path.description: Optional: relative path to the WS's plan/design doc inside its worktree.

notes.description: Free-form notes about coordination, special cases, etc.

allOf.description: If worktree is null, branch must also be null (WS produces no code PR).
